descriptions.cursum: Solo runner/FPS prototype built in one month in full autonomy.
descriptions.keep-dancing: Rhythm-based dodging game made in 48h for the Global Game Jam 2024.
descriptions.echoes: Action-adventure prototype in confined arenas, focused on fast combat and oppressive atmosphere.
descriptions.whispers: Narrative time-loop adventure in a peaceful low-poly village, where each loop uncovers new clues.
descriptions.color-gap: A minimalist platformer driven by color, rhythm, and perception. 🏆 Jury's Favorite — GGJ 2026.
descriptions.mirapyde: 2D parkour platformer with time manipulation: create a clone that replays your moves in reverse.
descriptions.eco: A puzzle-platformer where your past catches up with you, eight seconds late. My biggest project, playable in co-op.
descriptions.dig-or-die: The wolf learns. The shepherd traps. Short, tense, and fun.
descriptions.tour-infinie: A pixel-art roguelite auto-battler with online co-op. The tower has no top.
descriptions.speed-typo: Fast typing game with several modes and dynamic effects. Built with React.

tools.title: Also: Unity tools

descriptions.project-organizer: Restructure your Assets folder in one click into a clean, standard, professional file tree.
descriptions.code-harvest: Export, document and structure your Unity code in one click. Ideal for reviews, tech docs or AI training.
descriptions.class-diagram-generator: Automatically generate UML class diagrams from your Unity scripts. Perfect to document and visualize your projects.
descriptions.animation-path-visualizer: Visualize and edit animation paths directly in the Scene view. Drag keyframes, tweak tangents, display the speed gradient, and lock your selection. Works with Animation & Animator. Editor only.
descriptions.smart-localization: Editor-driven localization workflow for TextMeshPro: one-click translation via multiple providers (DeepL, Azure, Google, Amazon, MyMemory…), per-language locks, placeholder checks and dashboard.
descriptions.smart-localization-lite: Free, plug-and-play Lite version for TextMeshPro: LocalizedTMP, one-click translation via MyMemory, per-language locks and a daily quota managed from the Editor.
